<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#EEF4F1"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="44" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="27" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#012F3F">9:41</text>
  <line x1="320" y1="25" x2="320" y2="19" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="325" y1="25" x2="325" y2="16" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="25" x2="330" y2="13" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="335" y1="25" x2="335" y2="10" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="20" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <line x1="353" y1="23" x2="357" y2="27" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <rect x="365" y="14" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <rect x="367" y="16" width="14" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#28E292"/>
  <rect x="386" y="18" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#012F3F"/>

  <!-- Green header -->
  <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="142" fill="#28E292"/>
  <g>
    <polyline points="28,83 20,91 28,99" fill="none" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="21" y1="91" x2="39" y2="91" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="52" y="95" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#012F3F">Premium membership</text>
  <text x="24" y="132" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#012F3F">Read more. Live more.</text>
  <text x="24" y="158" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="regular" fill="#012F3F">Unlock the ideas that move you forward.</text>
  <rect x="24" y="169" width="128" height="24" rx="12" fill="#E6FC88"/>
  <text x="88" y="185" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#012F3F">7 DAYS FREE</text>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <text x="24" y="220" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#012F3F">Your annual plan</text>
  <text x="24" y="242" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="regular" fill="#707C81">The best value for curious minds.</text>

  <!-- Annual subscription card shadow -->
  <rect x="25" y="258" width="340" height="174" rx="3" fill="#707C8133"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="256" width="340" height="174" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#707C8159" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="24" y="256" width="340" height="30" rx="3" fill="#E6FC88"/>
    <text x="40" y="276" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#012F3F">SAVE 49%  ·  MOST POPULAR</text>
    <text x="40" y="318" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#012F3F">Annual</text>
    <text x="40" y="350" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="#28E292">$79.99</text>
    <text x="40" y="371" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="regular" fill="#707C81">per year after free trial</text>
    <line x1="40" y1="388" x2="196" y2="388" stroke="#707C8133" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="40" y="409" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="regular" fill="#707C81">Cancel anytime</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="250" y="337" width="98" height="36" rx="3" fill="#28E292"/>
      <text x="299" y="360" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">Selected</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Trial reassurance -->
  <circle cx="31" cy="461" r="9" fill="#28E292"/>
  <polyline points="26,461 30,465 37,457" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="50" y="466" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="medium" fill="#012F3F">Start with a 7-day free trial</text>
  <text x="50" y="487" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="regular" fill="#707C81">You won’t be charged until your trial ends.</text>

  <!-- Benefits section -->
  <text x="24" y="528" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#012F3F">Everything you need to grow</text>

  <g>
    <circle cx="39" cy="559" r="13" fill="#E6FC88"/>
    <polyline points="33,559 38,564 46,554" fill="none" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="66" y="564" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="regular" fill="#012F3F">Unlimited summaries and titles</text>
    <line x1="24" y1="580" x2="366" y2="580" stroke="#707C8133" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="39" cy="610" r="13" fill="#E6FC88"/>
    <polyline points="33,610 38,615 46,605" fill="none" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="66" y="615" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="regular" fill="#012F3F">Audio versions for every title</text>
    <line x1="24" y1="631" x2="366" y2="631" stroke="#707C8133" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="39" cy="661" r="13" fill="#E6FC88"/>
    <polyline points="33,661 38,666 46,656" fill="none" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="66" y="666" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="regular" fill="#012F3F">Send your favorites to Kindle</text>
    <line x1="24" y1="682" x2="366" y2="682" stroke="#707C8133" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="39" cy="712" r="13" fill="#E6FC88"/>
    <polyline points="33,712 38,717 46,707" fill="none" stroke="#012F3F" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="66" y="717" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="regular" fill="#012F3F">Sync notes with Evernote</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Action area -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="735" width="342" height="44" rx="4" fill="#28E292"/>
    <text x="195" y="763" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">Start my free trial</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="800" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="medium" fill="#1675FC">View all plans</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="812" width="390" height="32" fill="#02314B"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="34,827 43,819 52,827" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="37" y="826" width="12" height="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="43" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="regular" fill="#FFFFFF">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="137" cy="825" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="142" y1="830" x2="148" y2="836" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="137" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="regular" fill="#FFFFFF">Search</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="220" y="819" width="17" height="15" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="224" y1="823" x2="233" y2="823" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="224" y1="827" x2="233" y2="827" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="229" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="regular" fill="#FFFFFF">Library</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="325" cy="822" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="325" cy="832" rx="8" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="325" y="842" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Cera Pro, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="8" font-weight="regular" fill="#FFFFFF">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
